fieldValues.title: Is there demand for a graph element beyond the owner's projects?
fieldValues.thinking_reached: No option chosen. Raised as an open question in Research (6. Against: why graph features were removed and what to avoid), 2026-10-30, and turned into an exercise so options are explored before any decision.
fieldValues.tensions:
Options, none chosen:
- A. Proceed on internal evidence: the programme, the spec and muSrs are real users.
- B. Seek external users first, starting with demos like LiveWyer Insight.
- C. Ship the narrow core (one-hop selection, links, a walk) and measure who uses it.
fieldValues.unresolved_questions: Requests or friction from people outside the programme. None found so far.
fieldValues.next_action: Ask Dave and the next demo user what they tried to do with relations, and record it as findings.
